experiment: zero-model transparent-capture replay over frozen default-control mutators
method_constraints: execute archived Python unchanged except documented mechanical path-prefix substitution (/mnt/spreadsheet_data->pristine-input mirror, /mnt/spreadsheet_output->sandbox, /tmp->per-trajectory sandbox; quoted-string literals only; mapping recorded per execution)
no monkeypatching, no new imports, no openpyxl semantic changes
trajectory-order replay with accumulated state; file-creation/sed/file-op emulation for continuity only
base replay fidelity gate (Phase 0) before any capture claim; REPLAY_NOT_FAITHFUL/SOURCE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE excluded from denominator, reported separately
fidelity_hierarchy: F0 exact package bytes (record, not required)
F1 package-part identity + normalized XML equivalence
F2 workbook semantic/state identity (values, formulas, types, styles, dims, merges, names, tables, validations, CF, charts/drawings rels, hidden state)
F3 LibreOffice round-trip identity (recalc; subset where runtime allows + all opaque cases)

primary_gate.name: PASS_CAPTURE
also_required: no systematic failure in ordinary cell/formula mutation

environment.openpyxl: 3.1.5 (container used 3.1.x per viz trajectories; version skew recorded, F1/F2 insensitive)
environment.namespaces: unavailable (unshare EPERM); sandbox via path substitution, writes constrained to sandbox
